name: Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science
officialName: Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science (HITS), Deemed to be University
summary: Hindustan College of Engineering was started in 1985 under Dr K. C. G. Verghese and became a deemed university (Section 3 of the UGC Act) from 2008–09 as HITS. Its campus is at 1, Rajiv Gandhi Salai (OMR), Padur, via Kelambakkam. It is known for aeronautical and aerospace engineering and aviation programmes, and offers engineering, architecture, design, science, commerce and management degrees. B.Tech admission is through its entrance exam, HITSEEE.

testing.test: HITSEEE (Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science Engineering Entrance Exam)
